name: Ysolde Marrach
notes: A wizard with a real book, for the magic lane's tests and the cast-area audit (docs/fix-interfaces.md §3.4: every shipped pregen had an empty spellbook, so no live run could cast anything). Every 0-level wizard spell of the Core Rulebook's own list, as the book grants, and 3 + Int 1st-level spells, Burning Hands first. Nothing is prepared: her first night's rest prepares from the book in its own order (casting.ensure_prepared).
